recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-12677 unless a separate terminology cleanup asks whether the now-unbound audit-entity-type value set should be retired or reshaped for non-FHIR identifier use.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Security issue asking for AuditEvent.entity.type/object-type to include all FHIR Resource types because the value set did not expand as intended.
initial_application: Applied in svn revision 11573, now git commit d77b92a0d6e5c152b8db44042542cc8a8629707d, which changed the AuditEvent spreadsheet binding from an inline object-type code list to valueset-audit-entity-type and added a value set include for http://hl7.org/fhir/resource-types.
additional_context: AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published/Persuasive Security issues FHIR-32466 and FHIR-32467 removed AuditEvent.entity.type because AuditEvent.entity.what is a Reference; the combined branch already contains the FHIR-32467 source cleanup that removed stale entity.type narrative guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding resource types to the old audit-entity-type value set would target a removed element and conflict with the current entity.what Reference(Resource) model.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue for the same AuditEvent.entity.type/value set family; it resolved that entity.type should be removed because entity.what is a Reference. Decided opportunistically in this run.
